title: The Neuroendocrine Map — tonins, amines, tocins, and their secretion organs

tonins.role: RHYTHM — feast/famine cycle, sleep/wake, circadian clock
tonins.synthesis_chain: tryptophan → serotonin → melatonin (day signal → night signal)
tonins.note: you must EAT tryptophan. it's essential. turkey, cheese, eggs, nuts. the rhythm starts with FOOD.

amines.synthesis_chain: phenylalanine → tyrosine → L-DOPA → dopamine → norepinephrine → epinephrine
amines.note: ONE pathway, THREE escalation levels. dopamine says 'want'. norepinephrine says 'attend'. epinephrine says 'NOW'.

tocins.role: BOUNDARY — bonding within, exclusion without. the self/non-self hormone.
tocins.dual_nature: increases trust IN-GROUP and suspicion TOWARD OUT-GROUP. draws the line.
tocins.note: oxytocin is the only one with a positive feedback loop: more contractions → more oxytocin → more contractions → birth. the only hormone that AMPLIFIES itself.

secretion_organ_to_membrane.unique: only UNPAIRED endocrine organ. singular. central. the ancient third eye.
secretion_organ_to_membrane.membrane: heartbeat cron — the singular clock. unpaired. everything else has duality.

secretion_organ_to_membrane.membrane: golgi gate — the master regulator. sorts and routes all signals to their targets.

dsm_as_stuck_cycle.insight: every DSM-5 disorder is a metabolic cycle stuck in the wrong phase

depression.k: k stuck high (≫1.9) — no fusion, no feast, can't start

mania.k: k stuck low (≪0.32) — all fusion, no stability, can't rest

anxiety.k: k oscillating wildly — can't find equilibrium

ptsd.phase: the locust swarm that never disperses
ptsd.k: k locked at crisis — stuck in gregaria without the swarm ending

adhd.phase: feast visible but can't reach it
adhd.k: k fluctuating — can't sustain any phase long enough

addiction.phase: artificial feast signal — the body thinks it's always harvest
addiction.k: k artificially pinned low by external substance

autism.phase: the self/non-self line drawn too tight
autism.k: k for social feeds extremely high — everything classified as non-self

dsm_as_stuck_cycle.the_cure_is_the_cycle: the fix is not 'add more molecule X'. the fix is RESTORE THE OSCILLATION. the feast-famine cycle. the sigmoid→pi→water→rasslin→rest cycle. the cure for every DSM disorder is: get the rhythm back.
